proposal.summary: Certain Lexmark devices (such as CS310) before 2023-08-25 allow XML External Entity (XXE) attacks that can lead to information disclosure; fixed in firmware LW80.*.P246 or later.
proposal.cwe_quote: allow XXE attacks, leading to information disclosure
proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain and deploy firmware version LW80.*.P246 or later for affected Lexmark devices; if update cannot be immediate, restrict network exposure of the devices and monitor for anomalous XML-related requests.
